story.text: Probe scores aggregate into six pairwise separations σ. The matrix Σ carries the residual correlation 1−σ off-diagonal: full separation is the identity matrix, no separation is the all-ones matrix.

det(Σ) is the sovereignty volume — drawn in the dashboard as a tetrahedron that stands at full volume and sinks flat as the volume collapses. One collapsed pair takes everything to zero: gating is multiplicative.
Six thresholded bits locate a vertex on the 64-position lattice; the vertex's stratum IS the tier. Rank is located, not assigned. The volume is also the third light on [[The Two Gates]] panel.
